features: Category and severity with urgent operational warning
Authenticated case owner and verified accepted assignment binding
Multiple independent incident IDs per order
References and statements recorded as received; not proof by label alone
Substantiated result requires two different source parties and selected stored evidence
Reasoned decisions, revision chain, immutable events, exact idempotency/version guards
Driver appeal recorded by staff and evidence-backed uphold/revision
Existing open-cases queue and order-management entry
Existing incident remains bound to original accepted driver after reassignment
limits: Creation requires a currently verifiable accepted assignment; creating a new case for an already released historical attempt is not implemented
Driver self-service incident list and direct appeal submission not implemented; staff records received driver appeal
No numerical quality score, penalty tier or automatic account suspension
Open nonfinancial-case retention during account deletion requires separate audit; do not claim completed
Urgent severity is a visible triage priority; automated emergency paging or escalation SLA is not implemented
